(b) Rāhulovāda Sutta or Rāhula Sutta:
This discourse shows the Buddha"s continuous guidance to his son Rāhula. It teaches how to:
- Eliminate craving for the four requisites
- Abandon attachment to the five sensual pleasures
- Recognize the importance of noble friends as reliable supports

This sutta records the Buddha"s advice to seven-year-old novice Rāhula on the importance of truthfulness. - Usabharāja [usabha+rāja] - king of bulls
